sources.evidence: The Kiribati Ministry of Fisheries & Ocean Resources lists Kiribati Fish Ltd (KFL) as a current state-owned-enterprise joint venture with the Kiribati Government, Shanghai Deep Sea Fishery and Golden Ocean Fish Ltd.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Fisheries & Ocean Resources, Kiribati

sources.evidence: A Ministry news release dated 17 March 2026 identifies Kiribati Fish Limited and reports an official visit to its tuna processing plant in Tarawa, confirming the entity's current activity.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Fisheries & Ocean Resources, Kiribati
